title: Persistent announce trust store capacity is a permanent admission brick after 64 originators
description: Found by security+robustness review of project-LICHEN-worker6-dowx. AnnounceTrustStore::accept returns Full for a fresh IID once records.len() >= MAX_TRACKED_ORIGINATORS (64) and durable records are never deleted (deliberately no removal API, announce_store.rs:17-21,302-304); AnnounceProcessor::process maps any load/accept error incl. Full to AnnounceRejectReason::PersistenceError (announce.rs:250-252). On a persistent gateway, 64 distinct lifetime originators - trivially cheap for an attacker (throwaway keypairs, one valid announce each) - permanently reject all future new-origin admission, across restarts. In-memory LRU eviction cannot relieve it (durable check runs before memory admission). Availability-only (existing pinned origins keep working) but converts a bounded self-healing memory cap into a permanent remote DoS on gateway onboarding. Also: Full is conflated with corrupt/io in PersistenceError so operators cannot diagnose store-full. Needs a design decision: durable cap sized above real mesh population, or prune policy that preserves pins (key-change protection) while still preventing floor regression, or operator recovery path, plus a distinct reject reason for Full. Recovery today = manual deletion of state roots.
